visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot features a cheerful baby standing in a grey playpen with a man wearing a black baseball cap and white t-shirt positioned behind him. The setting is a brightly lit, modern living room with neutral-colored furniture and large windows providing soft daylight. (2) The scene shifts to a dynamic montage where three adults—a man, a woman with curly hair, and an older man—are bent over the playpen, struggling to hold a squirming, laughing baby down to change his diaper. The baby moves his limbs actively, highlighting the physical difficulty of the task. (3) The man in the black cap holds a clear package of MamyPoko diapers toward the camera, then demonstrates the product by vigorously stretching the elastic waistband of a diaper with his hands. He shows the texture of the material and the '360 degree' stretch capability. (4) A series of black-and-white and color clips show the baby sleeping deeply in various positions on a white-sheeted bed, including lying on his stomach and side. The lighting is low and soft to indicate a nighttime or nap environment. (5) The man performs a science-style experiment at a wooden table, pouring 70ml and then 500ml of dark blue liquid from a glass beaker into a diaper. He then firmly presses a white tissue against the inner lining of the saturated diaper to show no transfer of moisture. (6) The man and baby are back in the living room, which is now filled with various large toy vehicles, including a white police car and a red steam train. The baby sits inside the police car while the man crouches beside him, smiling. (7) The final phase shows outtakes where the man handles a very heavy, water-logged diaper, laughing as it hits the table with weight. He gestures toward the camera while talking in a relaxed, candid manner.
